sys_hub_flow.description:
Translate texts to multiple languages using Microsoft Azure Translator Service.

Inputs:

  • Texts - String array containing an array of texts to be translated.
  • Target Languages - String array containing an array of language codes to which the text needs to be translated. Ex: ['fr','it']
  • Source Language - Source language code of the text. Ex: en
  • Additional Parameters - Array of objects containing additional context parameters. Supported parameter is textType and its value should be html or plain.

      Ex: [{'parameter_name': 'textType', 'parameter_value': 'html'}].

Outputs:

  • Translations - Array of objects containing texts translations, detected language code, status, error message and error code
    • Text Translations - Array of objects containing text translated to the given target languages.

        Sample text translations response
        [
        {'target_language':'fr', 'translated_text':'Bonjour'},
        {'target_language':'it', 'translated_text':'ciao'}
        ]
    • Detected Language - Language code detected by Microsoft Azure Translator Service for the given text. Returned only if source language code is not populated in the input.
    • Status - 'Success' if the request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.
    • Error Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
    • Error Code - Code for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • Status - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.

Error Codes - Error Messages:

  • 40052 - Text ('text' field) has exceeded its maximum length.
  • 40053 - Source language is invalid
  • 40054 - Target language is invalid.
  • 40055 - Request is not authorized because credentials are missing or invalid.
  • 40056 - Text cannot be translated to target languages.
  • 40050 - Error code to populate error messages from Microsoft Translator instead of standardized error messages.
  • 40051 - Unknown error occurred.

To use this subflow, a corresponding Microsoft Azure Translator Service connection and credential must be created and associated with the Microsoft Translation Connection & Credential alias. Learn More

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>true</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes>browserActivatedIn=chrome,integrationActivatedIn=standalone,labelCacheCleanUpExecuted=true,timeFromCreateToActivate=148861339000,viewActivatedIn=naturalLanguage</attributes><authored_on_release_version/><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category/><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Translate texts to multiple languages using Microsoft Azure Translator Service.</p>
<p>
    <b>Inputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Texts</strong> - String array containing an array of texts to be translated.

    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Target Languages</strong> - String array containing an array of language codes to which the text needs
        to be translated. Ex: ['fr','it']


    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Source Language</strong> - Source language code of the text. Ex: en

    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Additional Parameters</strong> - Array of objects containing additional context parameters. Supported
        parameter is textType and its value should be html or plain.

        <ul>
            <br /> Ex: [{'parameter_name': 'textType', 'parameter_value': 'html'}].
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul>
<p>
    <b>Outputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Translations</strong> - Array of objects containing texts translations, detected language code, status,
        error message and error code
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Text Translations</strong> - Array of objects containing text translated to the given target
                languages.

                <ul>
                    <br /> Sample text translations response

                    <br />[

                    <br />{'target_language':'fr', 'translated_text':'Bonjour'},

                    <br />{'target_language':'it', 'translated_text':'ciao'}

                    <br />]

                </ul>
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Detected Language</strong> - Language code detected by Microsoft Azure Translator Service for
                the given
                text. Returned only if source language code is not populated in the input.

            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Status</strong> - 'Success' if the request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Error Message</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Error Code</strong> - Code for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Status</strong> - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.
    </li>
</ul>

<p>
    <b>Error Codes - Error Messages:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>40052 - Text ('text' field) has exceeded its maximum length.</li>
    <li>40053 - Source language is invalid</li>
    <li>40054 - Target language is invalid.</li>
    <li>40055 - Request is not authorized because credentials are missing or invalid.</li>
    <li>40056 - Text cannot be translated to target languages.</li>
    <li>40050 - Error code to populate error messages from Microsoft Translator instead of standardized error messages.
    </li>
    <li>40051 - Unknown error occurred.</li>
</ul>

<p>
    <b>Inputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Texts</strong> - String array containing an array of texts to be translated.

    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Target Languages</strong> - String array containing an array of language codes to which the text needs
        to be translated. Ex: ['fr','it']


    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Source Language</strong> - Source language code of the text. Ex: en

    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Additional Parameters</strong> - Array of objects containing additional context parameters. Supported
        parameter is textType and its value should be html or plain.

        <ul>
            <br /> Ex: [{'parameter_name': 'textType', 'parameter_value': 'html'}].
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul>
<p>
    <b>Outputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Translations</strong> - Array of objects containing texts translations, detected language code, status,
        error message and error code
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Text Translations</strong> - Array of objects containing text translated to the given target
                languages.

                <ul>
                    <br /> Sample text translations response

                    <br />[

                    <br />{'target_language':'fr', 'translated_text':'Bonjour'},

                    <br />{'target_language':'it', 'translated_text':'ciao'}

                    <br />]

                </ul>
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Detected Language</strong> - Language code detected by Microsoft Azure Translator Service for
                the given
                text. Returned only if source language code is not populated in the input.

            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Status</strong> - 'Success' if the request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Error Message</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Error Code</strong> - Code for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Status</strong> - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or 'Error' if a failure occurs.
    </li>
</ul>

<p>
    <b>Error Codes - Error Messages:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>40052 - Text ('text' field) has exceeded its maximum length.</li>
    <li>40053 - Source language is invalid</li>
    <li>40054 - Target language is invalid.</li>
    <li>40055 - Request is not authorized because credentials are missing or invalid.</li>
    <li>40056 - Text cannot be translated to target languages.</li>
    <li>40050 - Error code to populate error messages from Microsoft Translator instead of standardized error messages.
    </li>
    <li>40051 - Unknown error occurred.</li>
</ul>
